prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 is the key art of this game region. It is the PRIMARY reference: match its rendering style exactly - a dark, grim, detailed pixel-art scene painting with chunky, clearly readable shapes and flat shading (no soft airbrush, no photo texture, no film grain), the same leaning half-timbered houses with dark oak beams and grimy grey plaster, overhanging upper floors, sagging dark tile roofs, brick chimneys with thin smoke, wooden shutters, warm amber light leaking from windows, the same night mood and darkness. Image 2 is only a CAMERA reference: it shows the in-game camera - an orthographic top-down three-quarter view looking down from the south at about 40 degrees, no vanishing point, vertical edges stay vertical, every building shows its south-facing front wall and its roof sloping away. Do not copy image 2's composition or its brighter flat look; take only its camera angle.
PALETTE: near-black charcoal and cold ash greys carry the whole image, dark umber wood; ONE warm accent only - amber / ember orange to pale gold (#8b4d22, #d67a11, #e8b858, #faeec0) - used only for lit windows, door slits, lanterns and their small glow. No other hues: no blue, no green, no purple, no red.
LIGHTING: dim, even, cold night light on all walls and roofs (this art will be lit again by the game engine). Light sources are small: lit windows, a glowing doorway, hanging lanterns - they glow but do NOT throw big bright pools onto walls or the ground. Keep plaster walls mid-dark grey, never bright white.
WORLD: grounded Renaissance-era early-gunpowder slum of a liquor empire: oak barrels, crates, laundry lines, a hanging tankard-shaped tavern sign, broken bottles. Desperate, bleak, with a dry sly humor.
STRICT: no people, no characters, no animals. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no frame or border line. Fill the whole canvas edge to edge.
TASK: paint ONE very wide horizontal strip that is the NORTH BORDER of a top-down action-game arena in the outer back streets of the liquor city "Zan" at night. The arena floor (an open cobbled square) lies just BELOW this image and is not painted here.
CONTENT (left to right, one continuous street front): a row of tall, crowded 2- to 3-storey half-timbered houses standing shoulder to shoulder, their FRONT walls facing the viewer, seen from slightly above so the front walls are fully visible and the roofs slope back and up. Upper floors jut out over lower floors on carved wooden brackets; the houses lean against each other at slightly different heights. Include: a low tavern front with a glowing open doorway and a hanging tankard-shaped sign on an iron bracket (no letters); several shuttered windows, a few lit warm amber, most dark; a dark narrow alley gap with an archway between two houses; laundry lines with hanging rags strung between upper windows across the gaps; a couple of hanging iron lanterns; barrels, crates and sacks pushed tight against the bottom of the walls (low, not taller than a third of a door).
DEPTH: behind this front row, more roofs, gables and chimneys rise in two or three layers, each layer darker, smaller and hazier with distance, with chimney smoke - so the street front feels tall and the city deep. A dark overcast night sky only in the top tenth of the image.
GROUND LINE: the bottom of the house fronts sits on a perfectly straight, horizontal ground line at the very bottom edge of the image (a thin strip of dark wet cobbles at most). Nothing sticks out below it.
TILING: the strip will repeat horizontally - make the far left and far right ends similar plain dark plaster walls at the same height so they can be joined.
